title: Group Marketing Manager
company: Cherry Professional - Relationship Led Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
Group Marketing Manager
3 days based out of Hucknall, Nottingham - 2 days travelling Full-Time £40,000 - £48,000
We're recruiting on behalf of our client who are seeking a creative and commercially driven Group Marketing Manager to lead marketing activity across a diverse portfolio of attractions, events and customer experiences.
This is a hands-on leadership role for an experienced marketer who can combine strategy, creativity and commercial awareness to deliver campaigns that drive visitor numbers, customer engagement, revenue and brand growth.

The Role
You'll take ownership of the entire marketing process, from identifying audiences and commercial opportunities through to campaign development, delivery, optimisation and performance analysis.
Working closely with senior stakeholders, you'll develop innovative marketing campaigns that stand out in a competitive marketplace while delivering measurable business results.
Key Responsibilities
- Develop and deliver the annual marketing strategy and campaign calendar.
- Plan and execute integrated campaigns across digital, social media, content, PR, email and offline channels.
- Identify target audiences and use customer insight and market trends to shape campaigns.
- Drive website performance, SEO, paid advertising, social media and customer engagement activity.
- Lead content creation, campaign messaging and creative asset development.
- Manage the promotion of seasonal events, new attractions, launches and special initiatives.
- Monitor campaign performance, ROI and marketing KPIs, using data to optimise results.
- Manage marketing budgets, agencies and external suppliers.
- Build strong relationships across the business to ensure campaigns support wider commercial objectives.
- Identify new opportunities to grow audiences, increase repeat visits and enhance brand awareness.

About You
We're looking for a marketer who is equally comfortable developing strategy and rolling up their sleeves to deliver campaigns.
You'll have:
- Proven experience in a Marketing Manager or Senior Marketing role.
- Strong management experience.
- Strong experience delivering integrated multi-channel marketing campaigns.
- Excellent digital marketing knowledge, including social media, content, email marketing and paid media.
- Experience using customer insight and data to drive marketing decisions.
- Strong commercial awareness and understanding of ROI and campaign performance.
- Excellent project management and organisational skills.
- Creativity, initiative and the confidence to develop and present new ideas.
- Experience managing budgets, agencies and multiple stakeholders.

Desirable
- Experience within leisure, attractions, tourism, hospitality, entertainment, retail or another consumer-facing sector.
- Experience marketing events, launches or visitor destinations.
- Knowledge of SEO, PR and CRM/email marketing.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious marketing professional who enjoys creating innovative campaigns, identifying new opportunities and delivering measurable commercial success.

Cherry Professional are recruiting for this opportunity on behalf of our client. Please view our Privacy Policy on our website to understand how your data will be used if you apply for this role.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Role: Marketing Executive

Location: Nottinghamshire

Job Type: Permanent, full time

Salary: £35,000 - £40,000 (DOE)

Our client is a highly successful and rapidly growing B2 B organisation with a strong online presence and an ambitious growth strategy. As they continue to invest in their digital channels, they're looking to appoint a meticulous and proactive Web Content Specialist to support the ongoing development of their e-commerce website.

Working closely with the wider marketing and digital team, this is a varied and hands-on role offering exposure to e-commerce, product marketing, digital merchandising, content creation, AI innovation, and commercial analytics.

Product Content & Website Management
- Create and optimise engaging product content that drives customer engagement and sales.
- Maintain product listings, imagery, descriptions, pricing, and categorisation across digital platforms.
- Ensure website content remains accurate, consistent, and aligned with brand standards.
- Support the creation and enhancement of product pages to improve the online customer journey.

Digital Innovation & AI Development
- Contribute to the implementation and development of AI-driven tools and functionality.
- Support ongoing digital transformation projects and process improvements.
- Help identify innovative ways to enhance customer interaction and product discovery.

Product Marketing & Brand Development
- Assist in producing physical and digital product assets, including photography, packaging, user guides, and branded materials.
- Translate product features into compelling customer benefits and value propositions.
- Create simple visual assets, promotional graphics, and engaging social content.

E-Commerce & Trading Support
- Support promotional campaigns, seasonal launches, and website trading activity.
- Update homepage banners, featured products, and campaign landing pages.
- Prepare product data and merchandising information to support commercial initiatives.

Performance & Commercial Analysis
- Monitor product and campaign performance using sales, traffic, and conversion metrics.
- Produce reports and insights to support business decision-making.
- Identify opportunities to improve customer conversion and online trading performance.

title: Senior Marketing Executive
company: Michael Page Business Support - Agency - Permanent
description:
As a Senior Marketing Executive in the leisure, travel, and tourism industry, you'll play a key role in creating and delivering marketing campaigns that resonate with customers and drive engagement. Based in Nottingham, you'll focus on managing marketing strategies and ensuring they align with the organisation's goals.

Client Details

This company operates within the leisure, travel, and tourism industry and is based in Nottingham.

Description
- Develop and implement effective marketing campaigns to promote products and services.
- Analyse market trends and customer insights to guide campaign strategies.
- Manage digital marketing channels, including social media and email marketing.
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure brand consistency across all platforms.
- Monitor campaign performance and prepare detailed reports for stakeholders.
- Coordinate with external agencies and vendors as needed.
- Oversee content creation to ensure it aligns with marketing objectives.
- Support the team with ad hoc marketing tasks to meet project deadlines.

Profile

A successful Senior Marketing Executive should have:
- Strong experience in marketing within the leisure, travel, and tourism industry.
- Proven ability to create and deliver impactful marketing campaigns.
- Knowledge of digital marketing tools and platforms.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
- An analytical mindset to interpret data and optimise strategies.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and meeting deadlines.

Job Offer
- Salary of £35,000 to £36,000 dependent on the level of experience.
- Benefits to be confirmed.
- Fixed-term contract based in Nottingham.
